mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs and higher corporate profits.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate signals stronger labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns through improved profit margins and reduced recession risk.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 900 thousand units, it indicates robust consumer demand and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns as investors anticipate sustained corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 900, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95 (index, 2017=100) signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate output and profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as investors price in lower earnings growth.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high housing starts (HOUST > 900) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signal an expansionary economic environment with accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns through combined demand and liquidity support.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST > 900 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 100000) and elevated residential sales (RSAFS > 400000) indicate robust consumer spending power and labor market health, driving positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns via improved retail and services sector performance.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when both PAYEMS > 100000 and RSAFS > 400000, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), a decline in the federal funds rate is interpreted as a preemptive easing response to inflation, triggering negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns as investors anticipate future rate hikes to combat price pressures.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5 and FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In economic slowdown regimes (GDPC1 annualized growth rate < 1.0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 95) confirms manufacturing sector deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as investors price in reduced corporate earnings and demand weakness.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 annualized growth rate < 1.0% and INDPRO < 95, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.
